messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate (hosted). P50 latency ~2.4x baseline. Alert score 87. Affected keys: multiple high-throughput customers. Paging oncall.

sara-oncall: On it, paging infra and eng. @mike are you online?

mike: here. looking at canary telemetry — v2-quant-8 has repeated OOM retries on g4dnpool. Canary share at 10% so we're seeing spillover into prod pools.

ashok: logging shows KV cache miss spike starting ~14:10 UTC. Kernel selection changed in yesterday's runtime rollout; suspects there.

sara-oncall: options: full rollback, or route canary group to fallback model-variant (warm-standby) and keep runtime release for investigation. Warm standby v2-quant-8-safe is healthy. Prefer flag route to avoid churn. Thoughts?

mike: agree with flag-first. We'll flip only the canary cohort. Command I used locally:

```
redwood-flagctl set route.model_variant canary_group v2-quant-8 -> v2-quant-8-safe --dry-run=false --reason "live OOMs"
```

ashok: executing now.

ops-bot: Flag change initiated. Change id 0f3a. Target scope: canary_group. Progress: 20/100.

mike: also triggering traffic siphon off the most impacted hosts to reduce memory pressure:

```
curl -X POST "https://ops-api/traffic/siphon" -d '{"pool":"g4dnpool","drain_mode":"gradual","rate":0.2}'
```

emily: running quick functional checks against the fallback variant to verify correctness and latency:

```
for i in {1..5}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' | jq '.status'; done
```

emily: responses healthy. p50 ~180ms, no 5xx observed from these probes.

sara-oncall: ops-bot shows change reached 100% for canary. Monitoring realtime metrics for next several minutes.

incident-bot: Update: 5xx rate trending down from 6% -> 0.6% within 8 minutes post-flag. Latency back toward baseline.

mike: recommend keeping fallback routing for the canary cohort for 2 hours while we collect heap traces and validate kernel rollback plan.

ashok: prepping a rollback candidate for the kernel-selection change (kernel-select v1.14 -> v1.13) to test in non-prod first.

sara-oncall: customer impact summary: ~12 customers saw degraded tail latency, 2 experienced transient 5xx errors. No persistence/data-loss. CSE notified to draft comms.

lisa-cse: Acknowledged. Drafting targeted customer note for affected account leads, will provide copy for review within 30m.

mike: Post-incident action items for the RCA:
- tighten canary throttle and circuit-break thresholds
- add early-warning metric for OOM/retry cycles
- implement automated fallback route when 5xx > 1% for 5m within a cohort

sara-oncall: Good. Keeping the incident open for verification and trace collection. We'll move to postmortem in #postmortems after the retro. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
